sources.title: The Eagles’ trendsetting roster
sources.description: The Eagles roster is, in theory set for Week 1, though there is still plenty of time to make changes. Unintentionally, their roster construction led the way. Howie Roseman does it again! Fantastic 4 QBs There has been some consternation about teams carrying 4 QBs on their 53 man roster this year: the Eagles, Steelers, […]
